mcqs.question: Which statement is a common misconception about blood being classified as a connective tissue?

options.A: Blood has a liquid extracellular matrix called plasma that transports nutrients and waste.
options.B: Blood cells are suspended in plasma, which acts as the matrix of the tissue.
options.C: Blood lacks any extracellular matrix, unlike other connective tissues.
options.D: Blood originates from mesodermal tissue, similar to other connective tissues.

mcqs.answer: Blood lacks any extracellular matrix, unlike other connective tissues.
mcqs.explanation: Option C is the misconception: blood does have an extracellular matrix—the liquid plasma in which cells are suspended. Options A, B and D correctly describe features of blood that justify its classification as a connective tissue. Hence C is the only incorrect statement.

mcqs.question: Which of the following best explains why bone is considered a supportive connective tissue?

options.A: Bones are hard because they contain calcium phosphate crystals embedded in a protein matrix, providing strength and support.
options.B: Bones are composed only of cartilage, which gives them flexibility.
options.C: Bones have no blood vessels, making them inert structures.
options.D: Bones are primarily made of smooth muscle fibers that contract to support the body.

mcqs.answer: Bones are hard because they contain calcium phosphate crystals embedded in a protein matrix, providing strength and support.
mcqs.explanation: Option A correctly describes the structural basis of bone: a mineralized protein matrix (collagen) with calcium phosphate crystals gives bone its hardness and load‑bearing ability, making it a supportive connective tissue. Options B, C and D describe incorrect features not true for bone.

mcqs.question: Which type of cartilage is specially adapted to resist compressive forces and is found in intervertebral discs?

options.D: Cartilage is not present in intervertebral discs

mcqs.explanation: Fibrocartilage contains dense bundles of collagen fibers that allow it to withstand high compressive stress, making it the cartilage type present in intervertebral discs. Hyaline cartilage (A) is smoother and found in joints, elastic cartilage (C) provides flexibility in the ear, and D is false.

mcqs.question: Areolar connective tissue is characterized by all EXCEPT:

options.A: Loose arrangement of collagen and elastic fibers
options.B: Abundant ground substance that fills the spaces between fibers
options.C: High tensile strength comparable to that of tendons
options.D: Presence of fibroblasts that secrete fibers and ground substance

mcqs.answer: High tensile strength comparable to that of tendons
mcqs.explanation: Areolar tissue has a loose, flexible arrangement and provides cushioning and support, but it does not possess the high tensile strength of tendons, which are dense regular connective tissue. Options A, B and D correctly describe areolar tissue features.
